paite: Job in agentehna thu agen nawn a, hichi in achi.
heading: Job In Athubuai Agen Tawpna
english: Job again took up his parable, and said,

paite: "Aw nidanglai khate bang a om hi leng, Pathian in ahon veh lai nite bang in;
heading: Job
english: “Oh that I were as in the months of old, as in the days when God watched over me;

paite: Ka lutung a akhawnvak atan a, amah vakna a khomial a ka vak lai;
english: when his lamp shone on my head, and by his light I walked through darkness,

paite: Ka tuailai nite a ka om bang a, ka puanin tung a Pathian thuguk a-om lai in;
english: as I was in the ripeness of my days, when the friendship of God was in my tent,

paite: Ka kiang a Bangkim hihthei a-om a, ka tate ka kim a-om lai un;
english: when the Almighty was yet with me, and my children were around me,

paite: Ka kalsuante bawngnawi a sawp ahih a, suangpi in sathau luite abutkhiak lai in.
english: when my steps were washed with butter, and the rock poured out streams of oil for me,

paite: Khopi a kongpi zuan a ka pai lai in, kongzing a ka tutna ka bawl lai in,
english: when I went forth to the city gate, when I prepared my seat in the street.

paite: Tangvalte'n ahon mu ua, abu ua; upate athou ua adingh uh.
english: The young men saw me and hid themselves. The aged rose up and stood.

paite: Lalte houlim akidek ua, akam uah akhut uh akoih uh.
english: The princes refrained from talking, and laid their hand on their mouth.

paite: Miliante aw adai a, akam dangtawng uah alei uh abelh hi.
english: The voice of the nobles was hushed, and their tongue stuck to the roof of their mouth.

paite: "Bil in ahon zak lai in, hampha ahon chi a; mit in ahon muh lai in, pom ahon chi a;
english: For when the ear heard me, then it blessed me; and when the eye saw me, it commended me:

paite: Migenthei, panpih ngai a kap, Pa nei lou, panpihtu bei ka hutkhiak ziak in.
english: Because I delivered the poor who cried, and the fatherless also, who had none to help him,

paite: Mangthang ding a mansa a kipan vualzawlna ka tung ah ahong tung a; meithai lungtang kipah ziak a lasa ding in ka omsak hi.
english: the blessing of him who was ready to perish came on me, and I caused the widow’s heart to sing for joy.

paite: Diktatna ka silh a, ahon tuam hi; ka dikna puanak thupi leh lukhum bang leh suangmantam bang ahi.
english: I put on righteousness, and it clothed me. My justice was as a robe and a diadem.

paite: Mittaw a ding in mitte ka hi a, khebai a ding in khete ka hi.
english: I was eyes to the blind, and feet to the lame.

paite: Tasam a ding in pa ka hi a; ka theih louh thubul ka zongkhia hi.
english: I was a father to the needy. The cause of him who I didn’t know, I searched out.

paite: Diktatloumi haizek ka hihtan a, aha a kipan asamat ka khahsak.
english: I broke the jaws of the unrighteous, and plucked the prey out of his teeth.

paite: "Huchi in ke'n, ka bu ah ka si ding a, piaunel bang in ka nite ka pungsak ding, ka chi a.
english: Then I said, ‘I shall die in my own house, I shall number my days as the sand.

paite: Ka zungte tuite pha in adalhzak a, ka hiangte ah zankhua in daitui akai.
english: My root is spread out to the waters. The dew lies all night on my branch.

paite: Kei ah ka thupina athak gige a, ka khut ah ka thalpeu athak gige.
english: My glory is fresh in me. My bow is renewed in my hand.’

paite: Mite'n ahon ngai ua, angak ua, ka thuhilh a ding in adai dide uhi.
english: “Men listened to me, waited, and kept silence for my counsel.

paite: Ka thute zoh in apau nawn kei uh; ka thugen atung uah atakkhia.
english: After my words they didn’t speak again. My speech fell on them.

paite: Vuah ngak bang in ahon ngak ua; vuah nanungte a ding bang in lianpi in akamka uh.
english: They waited for me as for the rain. Their mouths drank as with the spring rain.

paite: Kimuanna aneih louh chiang un atung uah ka nuihmai a; huchi in ka mel tang apaikhe kei uh.
english: I smiled on them when they had no confidence. They didn’t reject the light of my face.

paite: "Alampi ding uh ka telsak a, hausa bang in ka tu a; sepaih pawl lak a kumpipa bang in ka leng a, suun mite lungmuanmi bang in."
english: I chose out their way, and sat as chief. I lived as a king in the army, as one who comforts the mourners.
